description: Two StartFragment/EndFragment pairs, no marker comments, naming different substrings
notes: The spec floats multiple pairs as a future extension for non-contiguous selections and nothing has ever emitted one, so a repeat today is a producer bug or a way to make a lenient reader and a strict reader disagree about which bytes the user copied. The first pair wins — the reading that cannot be changed by appending to the header — and Header::duplicate_keys records that a value was dropped. There are no marker comments, so the offsets are the only evidence and FragmentSource is OffsetsOnly.
